title: The Winter of Vessel Farm
author: T. M. Sandoval
blurb: Ivo Whitlock, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the well refills.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
